name: Gilman Peterson, DMD, MD
headline: Wisdom teeth, extractions and implants from a board-certified Lexington oral surgeon.
intro: Dr. Peterson is an oral and maxillofacial surgeon. His work ranges from a single tooth that has to come out to surgery on the jaw itself.

stats.label: Dental and medical, both from the University of Kentucky
American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery

services.name: Wisdom teeth removal
services.detail: One tooth or all four, including teeth that have to be cut out.

services.name: Tooth extractions
services.detail: A single tooth or several in one visit.

services.name: Dental implants
services.detail: A post placed in the jaw to hold a replacement tooth.

services.name: Bone grafts
services.detail: Rebuilding bone in the jaw, often so an implant has a solid base.

services.name: Denture-preparation surgery
services.detail: Reshaping the ridge of the jaw so dentures sit right.

services.name: Corrective jaw surgery
services.detail: Orthognathic surgery to fix how the upper and lower jaws line up.

services.name: Dental anesthesia
services.detail: Numbing or anesthesia, depending on the procedure. Ask about your options when you call.

about.heading: About Dr. Peterson
paragraphs: Dr. Gilman Peterson earned his dental degree (DMD) and his medical degree (MD) at the University of Kentucky, then finished his residency in oral and maxillofacial surgery there too. He is a Diplomate of the American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery.
Call the office with questions about your insurance or the cost of a procedure before you come in.
list: Credit, debit and tap to pay

photo.alt: Waiting room and front desk at the Perimeter Drive office

steps.heading: New patients
steps.intro: A few things to know before your first appointment.

items.name: Call the office
items.detail: Appointments are recommended, so call (833) 546-3522 to get on the schedule. Have your insurance card ready.

items.name: Fill out your forms ahead
items.detail: New patient forms can be filled out before your visit, which shortens check-in. Ask about them when you call.

items.name: Come back for a follow-up
items.detail: After an extraction you come back for a short follow-up visit so Dr. Peterson can check how you're healing.

reviews.author: Bobby Corwin
reviews.text: Amazing, friendly, very professional, and understanding staff. It feels like they really care about you. Had wisdom teeth pulled the other week and Dr. Peterson did it without any sedation, and I did not feel a thing, and I had little to no swelling and bleeding, which is the mark of a good Maxillofacial Surgeon.

reviews.author: Crystal Quick-Justice
reviews.text: Absolutely the best oral surgeon! I had to have 3 teeth extracted and cut out. I had a little pain the first day, but zero pain the next morning. The staff is very friendly. I would not go anywhere else!

reviews.author: Cathy Adams
reviews.text: My grandaughter had a tooth pulled and never felt a thing. Great experience all the way around.
